name: Average tract density masks
summary: Averages tract density masks with the same file name across several tractmasks inputs using FSL fslmerge and fslmaths -Tmean.
description: For each mask file name found in the inputs, concatenates the matching files and takes their mean to give one average mask per tract. Use it to build group-average tract maps from subjects already in a common space. As written, main calls ./average/sh instead of ./average.sh and the loop always looks up the first file name, so the App is likely broken.

inputs.description: Tract masks from several subjects or runs, with matching file names.
inputs.requirements: All masks must be in the same space and voxel grid.

outputs.description: Average tract masks, one per file name.

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check files and logs
failure_modes.fix: Check that the inputs contain mask files.
